title: Sixteen slot contracts re-measured with the final contrast probe, every heading, text and block of text judged: every one offered carries evidence of this round that passes; the WordPress variation writes followRules and sideRules and keeps kept bands light, EmDash takes followRules, the probe reads translucent fills, a text's own chip, photos, lazy pictures, skips text clipped out of a scroller and compares a text with its own default when the slot adds an element ahead of it
steps: S1: cd packages/design/tracy-ds-slot && node --test test/slot.test.mjs test/cms.test.mjs (the WordPress followRules, sideRules and kept-band light scheme included).

S2: for each of joomla-t3-bs3-blank, joomla-t4-bs5-blank, joomla-tracy-airbnb, joomla-tracy-base, joomla-tracy-business, wordpress-ja-{essence,impact,kinetic,morgan,nova,vega}, wordpress-tracy-base, wordpress-tracy-business, emdash-base, emdash-tracy-business, emdash-tracy-saas: loadContract, then read tasks/evidence/ds-remeasure-6-2026-10-11/<run>/final.json for every release it was measured on.
S3: build the EmDash slot CSS of emdash-tracy-business under Toggl Track and of emdash-tracy-saas under Apple (emdashCss).
S4: tracy-web's contractFor for Tracy SaaS (1.4.10, and its contract's minVersion), Tracy Business and Tracy Base EmDash at their released versions.
expect: S2: every ready contract's readyNote names tasks/evidence/ds-remeasure-6-2026-10-11 and its contrast kinds cover every heading and text; each final.json has systemsPass true, controlsZero true, regressed [], minFollows >= 0.5 and everyViewHasSamples true.
S3: the Tracy Business hero accent line on the ink band reads >= 4.5:1 under Toggl Track; the Tracy SaaS CTA eyebrow reads >= 4.5:1 on every ground of its card under Apple.

S4: Tracy SaaS's minVersion is 1.4.11 or later (1.4.11 was the first release that wears the slot; develop moved it to 1.4.12 on 12/10/2026), so 1.4.10 is told to update to minVersion and minVersion is offered; Tracy Business 1.7.6 and Tracy Base 0.5.0 are offered.

selectors.contracts: packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/templates/<name>.json ready, readyNote, followRules, sideRules, templateVars, keepScopes, selectors.button, selectors.card

evidence: tasks/evidence/ds-remeasure-6-2026-10-11/README.md: contract x first pass with this round's probe x after x numbers x what changed; screenshots read by eye.
fence: which of the sixteen contracts are offered and the evidence they rest on, and the WordPress variation keys this round added; not the stands themselves (measured once, committed) nor any release upload
